acceptance_criteria: 環境差による違いを記録
scope: Each CI build is made three times from fresh copies of the tracked files: A with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, TZ=UTC and umask 022; B with the same epoch but TZ=Asia/Tokyo, umask 077, another path and earlier file times; C without SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH. Every differing archive member and field is recorded. In CI run 45948159854 the controlled builds A and B were not byte-identical: the wheel's file modes (external_attr, 27 members) follow the build umask, the sdist's tar and gzip times (132 members) follow file and build times although SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH was set, and 12 sdist directory modes follow the umask; without SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH the wheel's timestamps (46 members) change as well. These differences are recorded in evidence/release/build-trial.json; no reproducibility is claimed.
